Built by scripts/build_extraction_fixtures.py from de/golden.yaml, not extracted by a model. Every quote is a real span of the parsed page its label cites, checked with the extractor's own _is_verbatim before this file was written.
Base: the 177 mandatory bid-eligibility labels recall is scored over (eval.recall.scored_labels), less every 13th (13 dropped), so recall is not trivially 1.00.
Of the rows kept, 23 quote(s) were widened and 19 narrowed against the real page, so eval/matching.py's tolerance is exercised in both directions rather than only on exact quotes.
Added on top: 1 contract-performance label(s), so ADR-0015's stage filter is scored in both directions; 2 sentence(s) from documents the answer key does not label, which no label can explain; and 2 judgement field(s) changed, so the disagreement list is not empty.
It exists so scripts/recall.py can be run end to end offline. The recall it yields is a property of this file. It measures nothing about the extractor.
